title: A plant cell
caption: A plant cell has everything an animal cell needs plus three extras: a cellulose cell wall, chloroplasts and a large permanent vacuole bounded by the tonoplast. Plasmodesmata cross the wall to join neighbouring cells.
alt: A plant leaf cell with labels for the cell wall, plasmodesmata, plasma membrane, cytoplasm, nucleus, mitochondrion, chloroplast, vacuole, tonoplast, rough endoplasmic reticulum, Golgi apparatus and ribosomes.
description: The cellulose cell wall lies outside the plasma membrane; plasmodesmata are channels through it.
The large permanent vacuole, full of cell sap, is surrounded by the tonoplast.
Chloroplasts carry out photosynthesis; root cells, in the dark, have none.
Like an animal cell it has a nucleus, mitochondria, rough ER, a Golgi apparatus and ribosomes.
